t: 盖拉尔德城堡(Château Gaillard)的围城以法国战胜英格兰国王约翰而告终,英格兰国…
te: The Siege of Château Gaillard ends in a French victory over King John of England, who loses control of Normandy to King…
dz: 盖拉尔德城堡(Château Gaillard)的围城以法国战胜英格兰国王约翰而告终,英格兰国王失去对诺曼底的控制而成为了国王腓力二世·奥古斯都.
de: The Siege of Château Gaillard ends in a French victory over King John of England, who loses control of Normandy to King Philip II Augustus.

t: 第四次十字军东征的十字军突破了君士坦丁堡的城墙并进入了城市,他们于次日完全占领了城市.
te: The Crusaders of the Fourth Crusade breach the walls of Constantinople and enter the city, which they completely occupy…
dz: 第四次十字军东征的十字军突破了君士坦丁堡的城墙并进入了城市,他们于次日完全占领了城市.
de: The Crusaders of the Fourth Crusade breach the walls of Constantinople and enter the city, which they completely occupy the following day.

t: 君士坦丁堡倒向了第四次十字军东征的十字军,暂时结束了拜占庭帝国.
te: Constantinople falls to the Crusaders of the Fourth Crusade, temporarily ending the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 君士坦丁堡倒向了第四次十字军东征的十字军,暂时结束了拜占庭帝国.
de: Constantinople falls to the Crusaders of the Fourth Crusade, temporarily ending the Byzantine Empire.

t: 鲍德温九世,佛兰德斯伯爵被加冕为拉丁帝国第一任皇帝.
te: Baldwin IX, Count of Flanders is crowned as the first Emperor of the Latin Empire.
dz: 鲍德温九世,佛兰德斯伯爵被加冕为拉丁帝国第一任皇帝.
de: Baldwin IX, Count of Flanders is crowned as the first Emperor of the Latin Empire.

t: 威尼斯共和国从蒙费拉特的博尼法斯一世手中获得了克里特的权利.
te: The Republic of Venice acquires the right to Crete from Boniface I of Montferrat.
dz: 威尼斯共和国从蒙费拉特的博尼法斯一世手中获得了克里特的权利.
de: The Republic of Venice acquires the right to Crete from Boniface I of Montferrat.
